newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT-ANZ a buy - Macquarie.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT-ANZ a buy - Macquarie.

text.p: Macquarie Equities Ltd said on Wednesday it had a buy recommendation on Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ), citing the Melbourne bank's diversified earnings base.
"Despite recent strong price movements, Macquarie view ANZ as fair value at A$6.63," the broker said in a September report.

Macquarie Equities, a unit of Macquarie Bank Ltd MBL.AX, said ANZ's Australian operations were supported by an international network with operations in more than 40 countries and a strongly growing financial services business. ANZ shares were steady at A$6.62 at 10.28 a.m. (0028 GMT).

"Macquarie Equities' buy recommendation is based on ANZ's superior strategic positioning, particularly in light of increasing competition in home lending, and the potential for ANZ to enhance profits through cost reduction," the broker said.
It estimated ANZ would increase net profit in 1995/96 (October-September) to A$1.064 billion from A$972.0 million last year.
